schedule.season: Season the game was played in.
schedule.fiba_game_id: Unique game identifier and the join key across all five datasets.
schedule.cebl_game_id: The league's own game identifier, distinct from `fiba_game_id`.
schedule.game_type: `REGULAR` for regular season or `FINALS` for the postseason.
schedule.period: The period a game was abandoned in, populated only for a cancelled game that had already tipped off.
schedule.venue_name: Arena the game was played in.
schedule.home_team_id: Team identifier for the home team.
schedule.home_team_name: Full name of the home team at the time of the game.
schedule.home_team_score: Final score for the home team.
schedule.away_team_id: Team identifier for the away team.
schedule.away_team_name: Full name of the away team at the time of the game.
schedule.away_team_score: Final score for the away team.
schedule.home_team_stats_url_en: English league stats page for the home team.
schedule.home_team_stats_url_fr: French league stats page for the home team.
schedule.away_team_stats_url_en: English league stats page for the away team.
schedule.away_team_stats_url_fr: French league stats page for the away team.
schedule.fiba_stats_url_en: English FIBA LiveStats page for this game.
schedule.fiba_stats_url_fr: French FIBA LiveStats page for this game.

team-boxscore.fiba_game_id: Unique game identifier and the join key across all five datasets.
team-boxscore.season: Season the game was played in.
team-boxscore.is_home: True for the home team, false for the away team.
team-boxscore.team_name: Full team name as published for this game.
team-boxscore.team_code: Three-letter team abbreviation as published for this game.
team-boxscore.coach: Head coach name. Null if the source recorded none.
team-boxscore.minutes: Total player minutes for the team, in decimal minutes.
team-boxscore.period_1_score: Points scored in the first quarter.
team-boxscore.period_2_score: Points scored in the second quarter.
team-boxscore.period_3_score: Points scored in the third quarter.
team-boxscore.period_4_score: Points scored in the fourth quarter.
team-boxscore.overtime_score: Points scored across overtime. Null for games that finish in regulation.
team-boxscore.field_goals_made: Field goals made, two-pointers plus three-pointers.
team-boxscore.field_goal_percentage: Field goal percentage as a whole number, already rounded by the source.
team-boxscore.two_point_percentage: Two-point percentage as a whole number, already rounded by the source.
team-boxscore.three_point_percentage: Three-point percentage as a whole number, already rounded by the source.
team-boxscore.free_throw_percentage: Free throw percentage as a whole number, already rounded by the source.
team-boxscore.total_rebounds: Total rebounds. Always equals offensive plus defensive rebounds.
team-boxscore.team_offensive_rebounds: Offensive rebounds credited to the team rather than to any individual player.
team-boxscore.team_defensive_rebounds: Defensive rebounds credited to the team rather than to any individual player.
team-boxscore.team_rebounds: Rebounds credited to the team rather than to a player. Equals `team_offensive_rebounds` plus `team_defensive_rebounds`, and is separate from `total_rebounds` rather than a subtotal of it.
team-boxscore.blocks: Shots blocked by this team or player.
team-boxscore.blocks_against: Shots by this team or player that were blocked by an opponent.
team-boxscore.team_turnovers: Turnovers charged to the team rather than to a player, such as a shot clock violation.
team-boxscore.total_fouls: All fouls charged to the team. Always equals `personal_fouls` plus `team_fouls`.
team-boxscore.bonus_fouls: Fouls committed while in the bonus.
team-boxscore.team_fouls: Fouls charged to the bench or the team rather than to a player.
team-boxscore.points_off_turnovers: Points scored on possessions that began with an opponent turnover.
team-boxscore.second_chance_points: Points scored on a possession that followed an offensive rebound.
team-boxscore.minutes_leading: Decimal minutes this team spent ahead on the scoreboard.
team-boxscore.biggest_lead: Largest lead held at any point. Null when the team never led.
team-boxscore.lead_changes: Lead changes in the game. Identical for both teams in a game.
team-boxscore.times_scores_level: Times the score was tied. Identical for both teams in a game.

player-boxscore.fiba_game_id: Unique game identifier and the join key across all five datasets.
player-boxscore.season: Season the game was played in.
player-boxscore.is_home: True for the home team, false for the away team.
player-boxscore.game_player_number: The player's slot in the game roster. Not a jersey number.
player-boxscore.shirt_number: Jersey number worn in this game.
player-boxscore.player_name: Abbreviated display name as published, in `F. Lastname` form.
player-boxscore.international_first_name: Given name in the source's international-transliteration field.
player-boxscore.international_family_name: Surname in the source's international-transliteration field.
player-boxscore.playing_position: Listed position. Null where the source recorded none.
player-boxscore.starter: True if the player was in the starting five.
player-boxscore.captain: True if the player was listed as a captain for this game.
player-boxscore.field_goals_made: Field goals made, two-pointers plus three-pointers.
player-boxscore.field_goal_percentage: Field goal percentage as a whole number, already rounded by the source.
player-boxscore.two_point_percentage: Two-point percentage as a whole number, already rounded by the source.
player-boxscore.three_point_percentage: Three-point percentage as a whole number, already rounded by the source.
player-boxscore.free_throw_percentage: Free throw percentage as a whole number, already rounded by the source.
player-boxscore.total_rebounds: Total rebounds. Always equals offensive plus defensive rebounds.
player-boxscore.blocks: Shots blocked by this team or player.
player-boxscore.blocks_against: Shots by this team or player that were blocked by an opponent.
player-boxscore.second_chance_points: Points scored on a possession that followed an offensive rebound.
player-boxscore.plus_minus_points: Team point differential while this player was on the floor.

pbp.fiba_game_id: Unique game identifier and the join key across all five datasets.
pbp.season: Season the game was played in.
pbp.action_number: The source's sequence number for the event within the game.
pbp.previous_action_number: The `action_number` of the event this one is linked to, such as the shot an assist belongs to.
pbp.period: Period number within its `period_type`. Overtime restarts the count at 1, so sort on `period_type` and `period` together or overtime events will sort in among the first quarter.
pbp.period_type: `REGULAR` for quarters one through four, `OVERTIME` for extra periods.
pbp.game_time: Clock remaining in the period as `MM:SS`, counting down from `10:00`.
pbp.is_home: True if the event belongs to the home team. Null on events that belong to neither team, such as period markers.
pbp.team_id: Team the event belongs to. Null on events that belong to neither team.
pbp.game_player_number: Roster slot of the player involved.
pbp.shirt_number: Jersey number of the player involved.
pbp.player_name: Abbreviated display name as published, in `F. Lastname` form.
pbp.international_first_name: Given name in the source's international-transliteration field.
pbp.international_family_name: Surname in the source's international-transliteration field.
pbp.shot_attempt: True if the event is a field goal or free throw attempt.
pbp.success: Whether the attempt went in. Set to true on every row where `shot_attempt` is false, so filter on `shot_attempt` first.
pbp.home_lead: Home score minus away score after this event. Negative when the away team leads.
pbp.x: Shot location along the length of the court, 0 to 100. Present only on `2pt` and `3pt` events.
pbp.y: Shot location across the width of the court, 0 to 100. Present only on `2pt` and `3pt` events.

officials.fiba_game_id: Unique game identifier and the join key across all five datasets.
officials.season: Season the game was played in.
officials.international_first_name: Given name in the source's international-transliteration field.
officials.international_family_name: Surname in the source's international-transliteration field.
